subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class provider-native video as a chat/model input, and which core or plugin contract plus security and fallback policy should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix would set product API, provider routing, model capability metadata, raw-media egress, retention, and fallback behavior that automation should not decide alone.

options.title: Approve first-class video chat input
options.body: Define the WebChat/Gateway/model-provider contract with security limits and then land or replace an implementation that follows it.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding workflows
options.body: Document media-understanding and existing video workflows as the supported path while deferring direct chat/model video upload.

options.title: Prove provider plugins first
options.body: Let provider-specific video implementations mature behind plugin-owned seams before adding a generic core chat video content contract.

recommendation.title: Approve first-class video chat input
recommendation.body: Define the WebChat/Gateway/model-provider contract with security limits and then land or replace an implementation that follows it.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior durable review comments already framed this as the cross-cutting product/security routing decision, and current attachment-line history also points to this area.
